task.title: Retire the renderer-parity test that pins the unknown-status divergence
task.description:
internal/presentation/parity_test.go:130-179, TestBoardsDivergeOnUnknownStatusesUntilThatIsCorrected, added in PR #33 (commit 3bf1e8b).

Acceptance item 6 of WB-01KY899X30206RKTM9XEBTZ4KA said the terminal/web divergence on unknown statuses "is being removed under a separate ticket, so sequence this after it or assert the corrected behavior." PR #33 did neither: it asserts today behavior - the terminal prints an `UNKNOWN STATUS (1)` section, the web board hands the client a task no column claims - because WB-01KZBT6J3R1YHG7Q2S6EDQ3JGJ ("Stop hiding unknown-status tasks on the web board") has not landed. The PR body acknowledged the choice.

Consequence: WB-01KZBT6J3R1YHG7Q2S6EDQ3JGJ now has to delete or invert a test that this PR just added, and defend doing so. That is the coordination cost item 6 was written to avoid.

Resolution, whichever comes first:
- If WB-01KZBT6J3R1YHG7Q2S6EDQ3JGJ is picked up, fold this in: delete TestBoardsDivergeOnUnknownStatusesUntilThatIsCorrected or rewrite it to assert the corrected behavior. The test comment at parity_test.go:130-135 already says it is the one that announces the change, and it will fail loudly when the divergence goes, so nothing is silently lost.
- If that ticket stalls, drop this second test on its own and leave item 6 to the parity assertions in TestBothBoardsPresentTheSameFactsAboutOneTaskSet, which already pin the canonical-column facts (prefixes, priorities, titles, labels, dependency summaries) for both renderers.

The half of the divergent test that is worth keeping either way is its check that both boards receive the same derived facts for the unknown-status task - the same IDPrefix on both sides - which establishes that the divergence lives in the web client column loop and not in internal/presentation.

Deferred from PR #33 because it is a sequencing decision that belongs with the divergence-removal work, not with the acceptance-coverage PR.
